tagline: Creating a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of financial health and the company's ability to generate long-term value, ultimate measure of progress according to management strategy

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Company's gross margin expressed as a percentage
kpis.description: TXN's gross margin decreased by 1.1 percentage points in 2025 (from 58.1% to 57.0%)

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Company's free cash flow, a key indicator of value creation
kpis.description: TXN's free cash flow increased by 15.3% in 2025, rising from $2.55B to $2.94B, representing 16.6% of revenue

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.description: TXN's R&D expenses increased by 5.1% in 2025, rising from $3.75B to $3.94B

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.description: TXN's capital expenditures increased by 7.6% in 2025, rising from $4.23B to $4.55B

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions with China
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned at the outset of the risk factors. The language is strong (geopolitical tensions, trade embargoes, sanctions). Dependence on China (50% of products shipped) amplifies exposure. Geopolitical category heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Increasingly sophisticated cyber threats
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed with alarming language (increasingly sophisticated, constantly evolving). It is cited as frequent and difficult to counter. Direct impact on production, data, and reputation. Cybersecurity category rising significantly in importance.

risks.title: Increased competition in Asia
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of China's rising strength through public policies and investments. Concerned language (increased competition, prevent us from competing effectively). Structural risk to margin and market share. Competition category of medium weight.

risks.title: Foreign currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: 60% of revenue outside the United States, clear exposure to dollar variations. Direct mention of negative impact on results. Factual language but recurring risk. Macro category important but less critical than Geopolitical.

risks.title: Supply chain shortages
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed with multiple causes (geopolitical, cyber, raw materials). Mention of extended delays, high costs, and limited supply. Concerned language. Industrial category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Dependence on external suppliers
risks.score_rationale: No long-term contracts with all suppliers, limited number of alternatives. Risk of inability to deliver or innovate. Mention of intellectual property risks. Industrial category critical.

risks.title: Difficulty attracting talent
risks.score_rationale: Mention of competition for engineers and executives. Risk to strategy and continuity. Measured language (no assurance). Key person category less critical but structural.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning was found in the text.
